headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before HARC Meeting on Wednesday, September 30
blurb: HARC holds a special meeting dedicated entirely to the Carhenge Redevelopment Project — the proposed new construction at 700 W Pacific Ave that has been working its way through review since at least July. Three separate Preliminary Large-Scale applications are on the table, each covering a different building cluster: Buildings A, B, and C; Buildings D1 and D2; and Buildings E1, E2, and E3.
